answers.implementation_then_now: Both the 2022 and 2023 US State Department religious-freedom reports describe a constitutional order that protects the free exercise of religion, with remedies before the Sala Constitucional. They report no government interference with religious practice. The one point they raise for foreigners is administrative: foreign religious workers must belong to a religious group accredited for migration control. Neither period shows a documented pattern of breach against migrants, so the rating stays at Usually; Effectively Always for both dates. The evidence covers the general population, not migrant groups specifically.

answers.sourcing_note: The consolidated SINALEVI texts carry amendment notes on each article. Arts. 19 and 28 have none. Art. 33 was last reformed by Ley 7880 (1999). Art. 75 was renumbered by Ley 5703 (1975). Ley 8764 art. 31 has no amendment note, and Ley 10493 (2024) amended arts. 33, 241 and 253, not art. 31. So the 1 Jan 2023 text equals today's.

answers.implementation_then_now: I found no report, in either period, of the state sanctioning migrants merely for holding opinions. UN Costa Rica hate-speech monitoring found Nicaraguans the group most targeted by xenophobic speech in 2022. In 2023, VOA reported a UN finding that hate speech had risen about 50%, with NGOs blaming presidential rhetoric. The 2025 report recorded a 16% fall in xenophobic speech. All of this is third-party speech and the rhetorical climate, not state interference with holding opinions, so the rating is unchanged.

answers.implementation_then_now: The protection answer is the lowest option at both dates, so implementation does not apply. No change in practice bears on the bar in art. 19 ('No pueden intervenir en los asuntos políticos del país').
answers.sourcing_note: Arts. 19 and 29 carry no amendment notes in SINALEVI, and Ley 8764 art. 31 is unamended. I found no Sala ruling in the window that narrows or extends the art. 19 bar.
answers.starting_answer_concern: Borderline. A search result (Bonilla Bravo, Revista de Derecho Electoral, TSE, 2022; not opened) states that Sala Constitucional case law confines the art. 19 bar to voting rather than all political activity. If that holds, the Yes reading becomes stronger. I did not read the ruling, so the starting answer is kept.
answers.notes: Art. 29 read: 'Todos pueden comunicar sus pensamientos de palabra o por escrito, y publicarlos sin previa censura.' The No follows the MRD's Mexico coding.

answers.implementation_then_now: The protection answer is the lowest option at both dates, so implementation does not apply. Two provisions stayed in force throughout. Const. art. 60 says 'Queda prohibido a los extranjeros ejercer dirección o autoridad en los sindicatos'. Labour Code art. 345(e), last amended by Ley 10235 of May 2022 (before the window), requires board members to be Costa Ricans or long-resident foreign spouses of Costa Ricans; Central Americans by origin count as Costa Ricans.
answers.sourcing_note: SINALEVI notes show that art. 345 was last reformed by Ley 10235 (3 May 2022), before 1 Jan 2023. Arts. 25 and 60 carry no amendment notes. Art. 404 was amended by Ley 10437, in force February 2024 (the gazette date comes from secondary sources; the PGR PDF could not be parsed), but the change does not bear on the indicator.
answers.notes: Ley 10235's entry into force in 2022 is assumed from its May 2022 date. Its text was not opened.

answers.implementation_then_now: Around 2022, UN Costa Rica hate-speech monitoring found Nicaraguans the group most affected by xenophobic discourse, with messages linking migrants to crime and to the use of health services. In 2023, VOA reported a UN finding that hate speech had risen about 50%; NGOs (Fundación Arias, Colectivo Nicaragua Nunca Más) said presidential rhetoric fuelled it and that no policies were in place to curb it. In 2025 the UN reported xenophobic speech down 16%, though still very high. Meanwhile the Sala Constitucional kept striking down nationality-based distinctions (2023-030411). The mixed picture does not change enough to move the rating from Sometimes at either date.
